jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Alma**



At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well\-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.



Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.



As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.



With 380\+ Almakers and €100M\+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!


### **About the team**



Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.



Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.



This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.



You will report to Basil Lizotte, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops \& Risk, Product and Tech.


### **About the job**



As Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.



You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.


#### **Build reliable data foundations for Revenue**


* Build and evolve business\-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.
* Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end\-to\-end data pipelines.

#### **Turn business questions into strategic insights**


* Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.
* Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.

#### **Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth**


* Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.
* Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.

#### **Drive data excellence across Revenue**


* Promote data\-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.
* Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.

### **You will work with**



SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce


### **About you**


#### **To succeed in this job**


* You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue\-related information, including Salesforce data.
* You have experience building business\-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.
* You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.
* You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast\-growing technology or fintech environment.

#### **And it will be nice if you also**


* You have experience with Looker and LookML.
* You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.
* You have worked with tracking tools such as Rudderstack or Segment, as well as experimentation methodologies such as A/B testing, significance testing and causal analysis.
* You are curious about AI\-assisted tools and are interested in using tools such as Claude Code in your daily workflow.


Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.


### **Your Alma experience**


#### **The culture**



At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast\-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.



You will have access to our Learning \& Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.



We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.


#### **The role itself**



If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:


* Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
* Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

### **Compensation \& benefits**


* **Competitive salary** based on 12 months
* **Profit\-sharing and employee savings plan**
* **Health insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma, including family package
* **Disability insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma
* **Sport**: partnerships with **Gymlib** and **ClassPas

jobs.title: Stage en Data Analyst Compliance et intégrité des affaires - Paris - Septembre 2027 (F/H)
jobs.description:
*C**hez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance.* *Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur.*

Nous recrutons des **stagiaires en data analyst compliance \& intégrité des affaires F/H**
A compter de **septembre 2027** **ou janvier 2028** pour le bureau de Paris
**Notre Opportunité :**

Le département Forensic \& Integrity Services accompagnent nos clients pour répondre à leurs enjeux d’intégrité, de compliance et d’éthique.


Dans un environnement où la réglementation compliance qui s’impose aux entreprises se renforce et où les exigences en matière d’éthique s’accroissent, notre équipe pluridisciplinaire intervient sur :

* La conception, l’évaluation et l’amélioration de programmes de compliance afin de minimiser leur risque de corruption, de fraude et, plus largement, de non\-compliance.
* Les investigations en cas de fraude suspectée ou avérée (corruption, détournement d’actifs, fraude aux états financiers, blanchiment d’argent, infractions à des règlements spécifiques), ou à la demande des autorités de régulation.


Pour ce faire, nous nous appuyons sur une triple expertise :

* Gestion des risques : compliance, contrôle interne, audit interne, audit financier
* Innovation digitale : financial data analytics, data science, digital forensic
* Connaissance de la réglementation (Sapin 2, FCPA, sanctions, etc.), au service de dispositifs opérationnels




**Vos principales responsabilités :**

Intégré(e) dans notre équipe IT Forensic, vous travaillerez sur des cas concrets d’analyse de données lors d’investigation de fraude ou de conformité légale (SAPIN2, GDPR, Secret des affaires etc…)

* Analyser des volumes de données importants en travaillant sur les opérations et les résultats financiers de nos clients (Groupes internationaux, CAC 40, …).
* Maîtriser les différentes technologies et architectures utilisées par nos clients (ERP, bases de données, etc..) et vous adaptez, si besoin est, les moyens d’analyse des données.
* Investiguer sur des suspicions de fraudes en développant des outils agiles : collecte de données, traitement de données et data visualisation.
* Intervenir dans un contexte international lors de missions avec vos collègues d’autres pays et vous êtes parfois en relation directe avec nos clients étrangers.




**Vos compétences pour réussir :**

* Vous maîtrisez divers des langages de programmation par ex : SQL, Java, PYTHON, etc…
* Vous avez une expérience ou une appétence dans des logiciels de Dataviz tels que Tableau Software, PowerBI ou Qlik.
* Vous avez des connaissances avancées en mathématiques/statistiques.
* Vous connaissez les problématiques inhérentes aux systèmes informatiques et vous avez une appétence pour les problématiques financières et un gout pour l’investigation.




**Ce que nous recherchons:**

* Vous êtes étudiante ou étudiant au sein d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une universitéavec une majeure en système d’information, en Dataviz ou en Datascience
* Vous recherchez un stage de 4 à 6 mois, dans le cadre d’une césure ou d’une fin d’études.
* Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de dynamisme et souhaitez vous investir dans une offre de services en fort développement
* Votre rigueur et votre autonomie vous permettent d’intervenir pour gérer des problématiques métiers et informatiques dans des situations variées et complexes de différents secteurs d’activités.




**Ce que nous vous offrons :**

* Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
* L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale.
* Une carte titre\-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75%.

**Etes\-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.**


Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 étapes ; des tests à réaliser en ligne, ainsi qu’une ou deux rencontres avec nos managers.


Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions.




**Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.**




*EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs et collaboratrices, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients à façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.*

jobs.title: Business Analyst F/H
jobs.description:
CDI
Créteil, France
35000 \- 60000 €/an
**Mission générale**
--------------------


Au sein de la Direction Data \& Expérience Client, le/la Business Analyst est garant(e) de la production, de la fiabilité et de la valorisation des données au service du pilotage de l'activité. Il/elle conçoit des outils d'aide à la décision (tableaux de bord, indicateurs, études) à destination des équipes métiers, en France comme à l'international, et contribue directement aux enjeux de performance commerciale et de maîtrise des coûts du Groupe.


**Détails de l’offre**
----------------------


* Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord de pilotage sous Power BI


* Recueillir les besoins auprès des équipes métiers (commerce, marketing, finance, opérations) et les traduire en indicateurs et solutions data exploitables


* Réaliser des analyses de données permettant d'identifier les leviers d'action prioritaires et les axes d'amélioration pour les équipes métiers.


* Assurer un pilotage dans la durée des indicateurs clés (KPI), en suivant les écarts et en alertant les équipes métiers en cas de dérive


* Prendre en charge l'analyse des résultats d'enquêtes (volet Analytics), incluant l'automatisation des traitements et la systématisation de la diffusion des résultats aux responsables de secteur.


* Travailler en mode transverse avec des référents métiers en France et à l'international afin de comprendre leurs besoins et d'y répondre par des livrables adaptés à l'échelle Groupe.

**Profil et expérience**
------------------------


* Formation Bac\+4/5 (école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou université) avec une spécialisation Data / Business Analytics.


* Première expérience réussie (stage, alternance ou poste junior) sur des missions de data analyse ou de business intelligence.


* Anglais professionnel apprécié compte tenu des interactions avec des interlocuteurs internationaux



Vos compétences techniques :



* Maîtrise avancée de Power BI (modélisation de données, DAX, création de dashboards et administration)


* Maîtrise de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles pour l'extraction et la structuration de la donnée


* Bonne connaissance du CRM Microsoft Dynamics et des problématiques de qualité de données associées


* Capacité à automatiser des traitements de données récurrents (Python, Power Query) pour fiabiliser et accélérer la restitution



Votre savoir\-être et vos compétences transverses :



* Sens de l'analyse développé : capacité à transformer un volume de données complexe en constats clairs et actionnables.


* Rigueur, fiabilité et autonomie dans la conduite des sujets confiés.


* Posture professionnelle affirmée et orientation entreprise/résultats.


* Appétence marquée pour les sujets complexes, abordés avec curiosité intellectuelle et engagement.


* Capacité à évoluer dans des contextes transverses et internationaux, en lien avec des interlocuteurs multiples.

**À propos de nous**
--------------------


Elior, filiale d'Elior Group, est n°1 en restauration collective en France. Depuis plus de 25 ans, nous anticipons les évolutions de notre métier, en devançant les attentes et les besoins des enfants, élèves, étudiants, travailleurs, patients et résidents…



Rejoindre Elior France, c'est rejoindre 17 000 collaborateurs engagés sur l'un de nos 100 métiers, qu'il s'agisse de fonctions opérationnelles ou de fonctions support. Nos 3 500 restaurants sont répartis sur toute la France.  

Faire partie de nos équipes fonction support, c'est apporter votre soutien aux équipes opérationnelles pour les aider à satisfaire quotidiennement nos clients et convives. C'est également l'opportunité d'intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution qui vous permettra d'enrichir votre expertise et vos compétences.



Comme nous, venez exprimer votre passion de la cuisine et du service, et évoluer dans un Groupe qui favorise la réussite par le collectif et le collaboratif.

This Business Operations Program Manager will translate executive priorities into actionable plans, provide clear visibility into business performance and supply\-chain risks, and help coordinate decisions across a complex global ecosystem of suppliers, contract manufacturers, engineering teams, capacity planners, finance partners, and logistics providers.

---------------


The Sr. Operations Program Manager (Sr. OPM) will work within the Device Operations group to develop the next generation of Amazon devices. The Sr. OPM will engage and work cross functionally across Engineering, Product Management, and Operations functions. The Sr. OPM will balance a mix of strategic, programmatic, and operational responsibilities to optimize new product cost, quality, and time to market. The individual is expected to work cross functionally to build consensus among the cross functional team and leadership. The individual will have experience in New Product Introduction in an Operations/Manufacturing role pertaining to Consumer Electronics (or similar) and have proven communications skills and ability to influence.

* Execute development builds by overseeing technical issue resolution and production schedule.
* Regular written and verbal communication to Leadership.
* Coordinate information flow across teams in support of manufacturing/operations.

jobs.title: Partner 20, Staff Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We've established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it's like to be in the founder's shoes. We've invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



We're hiring a Staff Security Technical Program Manager to run the operating system of the a16z Security team. You'll own the firm's vulnerability management program, drive cross\-team security initiatives to completion, and own the planning rhythm that keeps the team and its stakeholders aligned: sprints, OKRs, timelines, and the documentation and ticketing hygiene that make all of it real.



Security at a16z moves fast and touches every part of the firm. We work in close partnership with teams across the firm. Your job is to keep that work on schedule, keep decisions written down, and make sure nothing gets dropped between teams. Leadership should be able to get the real status from you, and engineers should see you as someone who removes obstacles, not someone who adds process.



This role requires an in\-office presence 2 days a week, Tuesday and Thursday, in our San Francisco, CA office, with occasional days in our Menlo Park, CA office.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
We know touch \- it's our only business. In fact, we invented the touchscreen over 50 years ago and haven't stopped since. Every 21 seconds, a new Elo touch screen is installed somewhere in the world. We obsess over details to exceed the highest quality standards. We don’t just sell things. We offer solutions to tomorrow’s challenges.

  

Elo is seeking a dedicated Project Manager, Security to drive Elo Software Engineering's execution of Project Aegis, a 16\-initiative enterprise security program running concurrently across five engineering teams, alongside Elo's regulatory and software assurance commitments. This role is the dedicated driver of that work: it exists so that security execution does not depend on the spare cycles of engineering leads already carrying the product roadmap.

 **Job Purpose \& Responsibilities:**

**Program Management — Project Aegis**

* Own end\-to\-end program management of Elo's execution against the various security initiatives and ensure Elo’s security posture is kept up to date.
* Maintain the master program plan: scope, milestones, dependencies, and critical path across all initiatives and the engineering teams they touch
* Own the two\-week reporting cadence into the enterprise security dashboard, delivering accurate and on\-time status without diverting engineering leads
* Track cross\-initiative dependencies and sequencing — for example, CI/CD consolidation preceding zero\-tolerance gate enforcement — and escalate slippage early
* Maintain the Aegis project in Jira as the single source of truth for initiative status, ownership, deliverables, and dependencies
* Drive each initiative to a named Elo point of contact, defined deliverables, and an agreed date

**Enterprise Interface**

* Serve as Elo's primary program interface to the named enterprise initiative owners across Enterprise Security, Product Security, IT, and the Software Engineering Tools \& Platform team
* Coordinate Elo points of contact and SMEs for each initiative's discovery effort, ensuring active partnership with initiative owners to define scope and resolve edge cases
* Represent Elo in enterprise program governance and interface with the enterprise DMO/PMO
* Translate enterprise requirements into Elo\-specific deliverables, and surface gaps where enterprise scope does not yet cover Elo platforms or systems

**Regulatory \& Software Assurance Programs**

* Manage the OWASP SAMM assessment program through to external audit, coordinating evidence collection and remediation across engineering functions
* Assist with PCI Secure Software Framework (PCI\-SSF) assessment activities, including documentation delivery
* Support product certification programs (EU RED cybersecurity / EN 18031 and related), tracking findings to closure across engineering teams
* Maintain a consolidated compliance calendar of regulatory and audit deadlines across all programs

**Prioritization, Resourcing \& Risk**

* Work with engineering leads to prioritize security work alongside existing product roadmaps
* Surface trade\-offs, capacity constraints, and resource asks to leadership with clear options and impact — before they become schedule risk
* Maintain program\-level risk and issue registers, and drive items to closure
* Track remediation and security debt reduction at program level, reporting trend and completion against target
* Facilitate working sessions between engineering leads and initiative owners to surface automation and AI\-enabled approaches to security workload

**Communication \& Governance**

* Produce executive\-level program status for Elo and enterprise leadership
* Run recurring program governance meetings, ensuring decisions and actions are recorded and owned
* Translate technical and regulatory detail for business stakeholders, and business priorities for engineering teams
* Other reasonable directives, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field
* At least 5 years of project or program management experience in a technology organization, with a minimum of one year in the security space
* Demonstrated experience running multi\-team programs against externally imposed deadlines (regulatory, audit, or customer commitments)
* Proficiency with Jira and standard project management tooling
* Strong written communication, with the ability to produce executive\-level reporting independently

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing security, compliance, or audit programs
* Familiarity with one or more of: OWASP SAMM, EU CRA, PCI\-SSF, ISO 27001, NIST, or IEC 62443
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, or equivalent certification
* Experience operating in a post\-acquisition environment where a parent company sets enterprise guardrails and the business unit owns execution
* Experience with cloud platform and/or connected\-device product organizations
* Proficiency in Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies
* Advanced degree

 **Specific Professional Skills/Competencies:**

* Ability to drive accountability and deliverables across teams without direct authority
* Sufficient technical depth to hold credible conversations with security and platform engineers, and to challenge dates and dependencies
* Strong dependency management across concurrent workstreams and competing priorities
* Highly organized under multiple simultaneous deadlines, with disciplined follow\-through on actions and evidence
* Clear, concise executive communication — able to reduce a complex program to the decisions leadership needs to make
* Proactive risk identification, with a bias toward early escalation over late surprise
* Demonstrated business ethics and a professional demeanor, leading by example

 **Physical Demands:**

* Ability to lift up to OSHA single person lift requirements
* Ability to sit, stand, bend, or walk for prolong

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Infrastructure Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
Technical Program Management \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization builds and operates the infrastructure required to train and serve frontier AI models. The Capacity Planning team connects rapidly changing research and product demand with the compute, networking, storage, power, data center, hardware, and operational resources required to make that demand executable.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to build and lead capacity planning across OpenAI's large\-scale AI infrastructure. You will translate uncertain workload demand into clear infrastructure requirements, allocation decisions, supply commitments, activation priorities, and long\-range capacity strategies.


This role sits at the intersection of research, engineering, infrastructure, finance, sourcing, deployment, and operations. You will create the planning models, operating cadences, governance mechanisms, and source\-of\-truth systems that allow teams to understand what capacity is required, what is available, what is at risk, and what decisions must be made.


This is not a finance\-only forecasting or reporting role. Success requires technical fluency across the infrastructure stack, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to move consequential decisions forward when requirements, timelines, and supply conditions change quickly.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own capacity\-planning processes across near\-term workload allocation, quarterly execution, and longer\-range infrastructure horizons.
* Translate research, training, inference, and product demand into compute, accelerator, cluster, networking, storage, rack, power, and site requirements.
* Develop scenarios that make assumptions, confidence levels, constraints, sensitivities, and decision points explicit.
* Reconcile requested demand against contracted, delivered, installed, activated, and workload\-usable capacity.
* Partner with research and engineering teams to understand workload priorities, technical dependencies, utilization patterns, and changing requirements.
* Partner with sourcing, finance, hardware, deployment, and operations teams to align supply commitments, activation schedules, costs, and delivery risks.
* Support allocation and prioritization decisions when infrastructure is constrained or delivery plans change.
* Track infrastructure lead times, critical dependencies, utilization, headroom, forecast accuracy, activation readiness, and capacity risk.
* Build dashboards, analytical tools, executive updates, and operating cadences that create a credible source of truth.
* Drive mitigation plans for site delays, hardware shortages, network or storage constraints, workload changes, and other capacity risks.
* Continuously improve planning models, governance, data quality, and accountability as OpenAI's infrastructure scales.

**Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in technical program management, infrastructure capacity planning, cloud infrastructure, supply planning, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated ownership of capacity planning for large\-scale distributed systemss, AI or ML workloads, or hyperscale infrastructure.
* Ability to translate ambiguous demand into structured assumptions, scenarios, technical resource requirements, and executable plans.
* Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center infrastructure, utilization, reliability, and deployment dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience developing planning models, operational metrics, dashboards, or data\-driven decision systems.
* Experience leading decisions across engineering, finance, sourcing, deployment, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain uncertainty, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly.

**Preferred Skills**


* Experience planning GPU, accelerator, or AI infrastructure capacity for training or inference workloads.
* Experience with cluster allocation, cloud capacity, hardware supply, infrastructure procurement, site readiness, or production activation.
* Familiarity with forecasting methods, scenario planning, optimization, cost attribution, capacity economics, and utilization management.
* Experience building planning tools or source\-of\-truth systems using SQLs, or similar technologies.
* Track record of improving utilization, reducing infrastructure cost or risk, and enabling critical workloads during periods of constrained supply.

**Location**


San Francisco, California. This role requires regular in\-person collaboration with infrastructure, research, and operational partners.


**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.


We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.

  


At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

$257K – $335K \+ Offers Equity

jobs.title: Contingent Worker Program Manager (Contract)
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**


We're looking for a Contingent Worker Program Manager to build our contingent workforce program from the ground up. This is a foundational role: you'll assess our current policies and practices, identify risk areas, and design the frameworks, processes, and SOPs that will govern how we engage, onboard, and manage contingent workers as we scale. Your work will directly shape how the company manages compliance risk, cost, and operational efficiency across a growing contingent workforce.


The ideal candidate has deep, hands\-on experience standing up or overhauling contingent workforce programs in a high\-growth environment, is comfortable operating with significant ambiguity, and can move fluidly between strategic program design and day\-to\-day operational execution. This is a contract position, ideal for someone who thrives on building programs from scratch and can hit the ground running with minimal ramp\-up time.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Policy Review \& Redesign:** Audit our current contingent worker policies and practices, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* **Program Build:** Design and implement a comprehensive contingent worker program from the ground up, including governance, classification guidelines, and engagement workflows.
* **Risk Assessment:** Evaluate current practices for compliance, misclassification, and operational risk, and recommend mitigation strategies.
* **SOP Development:** Build clear, scalable standard operating procedures for contingent worker intake, onboarding, and offboarding.
* **Onboarding \& Offboarding Management :** Own and improve the end\-to\-end onboarding experience for contingent workers, ensuring consistency and compliance.
* **Procurement Partnership:** Partner closely with Procurement to align on vendor management, statement\-of\-work processes, and contingent labor spend.
* **Day\-to\-Day Operations:** Manage ongoing operational duties related to contingent worker requests, approvals, and system tracking.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work cross\-functionally with Legal, HR, Finance, and hiring managers to ensure the program meets business and compliance needs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5\+ years of experience managing contingent workforce, vendor management, or contractor/staffing programs.
* Demonstrated experience building or significantly overhauling a contingent worker program, ideally within a high\-growth company.
* Strong understanding of worker classification, compliance risk, and contingent labor best practices.
* Proven experience partnering with Procurement on vendor and statement\-of\-work processes.
* Hands\-on experience developing SOPs and operational documentation.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to balance strategic design work with daily operational demands.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across HR, Legal, Finance, and business teams.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with VMS (Vendor Management System) platforms
* Background in a legal, compliance, or risk\-focused function related to contingent labor.
* Experience working in a fast\-scaling startup or tech company.
* Familiarity with global contingent workforce considerations (if applicable to the business).

**Compensation Range**


Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $60\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.


Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Legal \- San Francisco and New York City

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment.


**About the Role**


As a Legal Program Manager focused on regulatory compliance, you will build and manage cross\-functional programs that translate counsel’s guidance into practical, sustainable operations. Your initial focus may include content moderation and/or frontier AI governance, with the mix shaped by team priorities and your strengths.


You will partner with internal and external counsel, other legal program managers, and technical and business teams to coordinate implementation, evidence collection, reporting, and ongoing compliance. You’ll build repeatable systems that scale across regulations, products, and jurisdictions, helping teams navigate emerging requirements with clarity and sound judgment.


This full\-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY.


**In this role, you will:**


* Lead regulatory compliance programs end to end: define scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths, and drive execution with counsel and cross\-functional partners.
* Translate counsel’s regulatory guidance into repeatable workflows, controls, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include content moderation disclosures, transparency reporting, reporting and appeals workflows, or frontier AI model launch readiness, evaluation and risk\-management evidence, and incident reporting.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, User Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Global Affairs, Communications, and Go\-to\-Market to align program priorities and deliverables.
* Support regulatory inquiries, audits and investigations with counsel, organizing evidence and responses to support timely, accurate communication and reporting.
* Maintain a reliable source of truth for obligations, controls, decisions, evidence, and reporting. Demonstrate compliance readiness and control effectiveness, and improve program timeliness and evidence quality.
* Identify execution risks and compliance gaps, track remediation, and escalate blockers. Establish clear success measures and operating cadences, keeping legal conclusions subject to counsel’s review.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**


* Have 6\+ years of experience in program management, regulatory compliance, or related fields in a tech\-forward or highly regulated environment, including relevant legal, regulatory, or compliance program experience.
* Have experience working with an in\-house legal team; regulatory matters experience and in\-house technology experience are strongly preferred.
* Have demonstrated experience building and scaling compliance programs, translating legal or regulatory requirements into operational workflows, and maintaining reliable documentation and evidence in partnership with counsel.
* Take ownership of complex projects, set and achieve milestones, synthesize cross\-functional input, and build trust across legal, technical, and business teams.
* Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and make progress through ambiguity.

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. Recruiting for this role ends on October 31, 2026  

  

**Work You'll Do**  

  

As a Manager, Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation, you will be responsible for:  

* Working on integrated project teams on a range of projects covering the entire lifecycle from strategy formulation through to design, development and the deployment of solutions.
* Bringing considerable billing management expertise to help design, develop and implement subscription billing solutions to transform client's billing processes.
* Interacting daily with key business and IT executives
* Leading multiple teams in various strategy and implementation activities.
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues
* Determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches
* Evaluating and validate analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Implementing and overseeing the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day\-to\-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.

  

The successful Manager you will possess:  

* Strong communication skills \- ability to communicate complex system concepts to a business audience in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to facilitate clients' most complex business requirements
* Knowledge of basic accounting policies, and implications
* Experience identifying creative solutions within configurable cloud systems or within boundary applications where customization is required
* Leadership \- proven ability to lead complex engagements, both business and technical, including multiple dependencies and integration points
* Problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment

  

**The Team**  

  

Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 5\+ years experience in subscription billing within consulting or industry, specifically focused on delivering cloud\-based subscription billing solutions
* 5\+ years experience with end\-to\-end implementations of Subscription Billing solutions (e.g. Zuora Billing, Oracle NetSuite, SAP BRIM)
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* A Bachelor's degree

* 4\+ years of experience conducting architecture assessments and developing implementation roadmaps for subscription billing solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience designing and configuring cloud or SaaS\-based billing solutions in complex, multi\-entity environments.
* 3\+ years of experience designing integrations with upstream systems (such as Ordering, Provisioning) and downstream ERP applications (such as General Ledger)
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing teams of 5 or more people, including responsibility for performance, deliverables, and team development.

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  


Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

Stanford Health Care's Enterprise Contact Center (ECC) serves as a shared services platform supporting patient scheduling, nurse triage, referral coordination, and multi\-specialty contact center operations across the SHC care delivery network. The CRM Program Manager owns the Epic CRM program for the enterprise contact center ecosystem — the taxonomy, standards, governance, and operational workflows that determine how every patient contact is categorized, routed, documented, and reported. This role is the connective tissue between Epic's Contact Hub and CRM capabilities, the Panviva knowledge base, the new omnichannel platform's CTI integration, and the operational teams who rely on all of them working together seamlessly. Business requirements, workflow validation, UAT, and operational sign\-off are owned by this role; Epic/TDS teams own technical build, configuration, functional testing, and integration testing.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care  

  

**What you will do*** Epic CRM Program Ownership
* Owns the Epic CRM program including taxonomy, standards, foundational structure, and governance to ensure consistency across ECC and non\-ECC contact center teams.
* Defines the CRM standards framework for new builds, modifications, naming conventions, categories, outcomes, and documentation practices, and hold Epic/TDS technical teams accountable for consistent application across all contact center environments to support operational consistency, reporting integrity, and omnichannel readiness.
* Serves as the single business owner of the CRM data model — defining and enforcing the hierarchy of contact types, categories, subcategories, dispositions, and follow\-up actions that agents select to classify every patient interaction across the enterprise, ensuring the taxonomy supports cascading navigation and consistent disposition selection.
* Epic Contact Hub \& Workflow Operations
* Serves as the operational lead for Epic Contact Hub workflows, ensuring configurations, CRM workflows, and the agent experience remain aligned to operational needs and future omnichannel capabilities.
* Develops deep expertise in Epic scheduling decision trees and own the navigation between CRM workflows and decision tree usage to create a seamless staff experience and reduce workflow friction during patient interactions.
* Designs and optimizes agent\-facing workflows that minimize clicks, reduce cognitive load, and guide staff through complex patient scenarios (multi\-department scheduling, referral chains, prior authorization) with contextual CRM prompts.
* Leads User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CRM workflow changes prior to deployment, validating that business requirements are met and operational workflows perform as expected; functional testing, configuration testing, and integration testing are owned by Epic/TDS technical teams.
* Knowledge Base Alignment \& Content Governance
* Ensures CRM follow\-up actions, dispositions, and next steps are appropriately classified and aligned with Panviva knowledge base content so that guidance remains intuitive, duplication is minimized, and staff receive a consistent experience across systems.
* Partners with the knowledge management team to maintain a mapping between CRM disposition codes and corresponding Panviva articles — ensuring that when an agent selects a disposition, the relevant guidance surfaces automatically.
* Identifies and remediates content drift: cases where CRM workflow changes have made knowledge base articles stale, or where new knowledge base content requires corresponding CRM taxonomy updates.
* Supports the transition from Panviva to any future knowledge management platform (e.g., CXone Expert, Genesys Knowledge) by ensuring CRM\-to\-KB mappings are documented and portable.
* Governance, Intake \& Change Management
* Oversees CRM governance, intake, prioritization, and change review to ensure CRM changes are vetted against standards and evaluated for impact to routing logic, reporting, Contact Hub workflows, knowledge base dependencies, and integrations.
* Partners with Epic, TDS, operations, PMO, and other stakeholders to evaluate CRM\-related requests, define business requirements, and assess downstream impact prior to implementation.
* Establishes a CRM change advisory process: no CRM taxonomy or workflow change goes to production without documented impact assessment covering routing, reporting, KB alignment, and agent experience.
* Owns the end\-to\-end operational change management for omnichannel CTI and Epic CRM rollout, ensuring workflows, documentation standards, staff readiness, and adoption are implemented in a coordinated manner.
* Develops and delivers CRM\-specific training for new agents, supervisors, and operational leads — not just how to use the system, but why the taxonomy matters and how their inputs drive downstream reporting and patient experience.
* Reporting \& Data Integrity
* Drives CRM reporting maturity by partnering on reporting standards, data integrity, and sustainable reporting structures to support operational insights and decision\-making.
* Defines and monitors CRM data quality metrics: disposition completion rates, categorization accuracy, decision tree completion rates, and follow\-up action closure rates.
* Partners with the Reporting/BI Analyst to design CRM\-sourced dashboards that give operations leaders visibility into contact patterns, resolution rates, escalation trends, and agent workflow efficiency.

jobs.title: Data Center Program Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a detail oriented, customer obsessed Program Manager for its Infrastructure Operations team.
  

  

Our Program Managers are able to quickly adapt strategies, plans and solutions in response to dynamic business requirements. They also must be comfortable interfacing and driving various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. If you have previous project engineering experience, are ready to take on challenges, open minded, appreciate team comradely, have an occasional sense of humor and want to help Amazon raise the bar, then this role is for you!  

  

Successful candidates are natural self\-starters who possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges while driving these solutions to completion. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi\-disciplinary teams (internal operations, engineering, legal, finance, procurement, environmental/health/safety, etc.). This individual has strong communication skills, is organized and thrive in ambiguity.
  

  

The scope of role encompasses program management of capital expense (CAPEX) and/or operational expense (OPEX) projects within data center operations. The scope of projects will include but not be limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection, building improvements, vendor (partner) management, and cluster wide maintenance coordination. An understanding of these systems is necessary, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other teams and organizations.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Manage requirements, budget, design, and implementation of assigned projects  

  

Assess annual maintenance program requirements and build a rolling 18 month project forecast  

  

Facilitate creation of SOWs with partner teams to be included in contract documents including RFQ/RFPs, change order controls, purchase orders, and invoicing.  

  

Evaluate performance and work product of on\-site partners and escalate issues through Amazon leadership.  

  

Identify and communicate needs for design improvements.  

  

Monitor and enforce project schedules and quality with, operational teams, cross functional amazon team members, and partners.  

  

Lead and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside partners including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout.  

  

Evaluate project risks and issues and propose actionable resolutions.  

  

Build strong working relationships with data center leadership teams across multiple sites as well as other internal stakeholders (operations, finance, safety, security, legal, procurement).  

  

General knowledge of data center operations and facility management.  

  

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects  

  

Ability to follow accurate and complete support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries.  

  

Proactively and continually improve your level of knowledge about data center relevant technologies.

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

As one of the technology industry's most desirable employers, NVIDIA is an industry leader in high performance computing, gaming and AI. NVIDIA's GPUs are extraordinary in performance and efficiency, and we are continually innovating in creative ways to deliver outstanding solutions in a wide range of sectors. We are looking for a Senior Fulfillment \& Logistics Data Analyst to provide advanced analytics, operational insights, and data\-supported solutions spanning our international fulfillment, warehousing, and transportation network. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in innovation at a company that is setting the stage for the future of computing!


This role will convert detailed Fulfillment \& Logistics data into useful intelligence that improves delivery performance, warehouse management, cycle time, inventory accuracy, transportation efficiency, cost, and customer experience.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Develop and maintain end\-to\-end analytics across inbound transportation, warehouse operations, inventory, outbound fulfillment, transportation, and final delivery.
* Analyze operational performance to identify bottlenecks, process gaps, capacity constraints, and opportunities to improve cycle time and service levels.
* Conduct root\-cause and Pareto analysis to identify systemic drivers of operational failures and recurring exceptions.

**Role:** Technical Program Manager
  
**Location:** Toronto, ON \& Berkeley Heights, NJ (Day 1 Onsite)
  
**Duration:** FTE
  
Role Summary
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager / Technical Program Lead to drive the integration capabilities into Client's ecosystem. The successful candidate will lead complex cross\-functional initiatives spanning deposit products, core banking platforms, APIs, data integrations, cloud technologies, and regulated financial services platforms.
  
The role will serve as the primary coordination point between Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Compliance, Finxact, SC Trust, INDX, and external banking partners to ensure successful delivery of strategic integration initiatives. The program includes enabling insured deposit products, merchant savings solutions, payment integrations, digital asset\-related capabilities, and enterprise platform modernization efforts
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Program Leadership
  
Lead end\-to\-end delivery of integration initiatives across multiple business and technology workstreams.
  
Establish program governance, delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency management, and executive reporting.
  
Coordinate delivery activities across Product, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, Security, Compliance, and vendor teams.
  
Drive program execution from initiation through production deployment and post\-launch support.
  
Technical Delivery Management
  
Partner with engineering teams to design and deliver integrations involving:
  
Core banking platform
  
Customer portals and APIs
  
Trust systems
  
Deposit Network services
  
Merchant and payment platforms
  
External banking partners and service providers
  
Manage API, data, cloud, and operational integration workstreams.
  
Facilitate technical design reviews and architecture discussions.
  
Identify and remove delivery blockers across teams.
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and milestones to leadership.
  
Drive consensus across competing priorities and stakeholders.
  
Support integration activities involving acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.
  
Risk \& Compliance Management
  
Ensure delivery aligns with security, regulatory, and operational requirements.
  
Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Information Security teams throughout program execution.
  
Drive readiness activities including operational procedures, support models, business continuity, and production governance.
  
Planning \& Execution
  
  

**Develop and maintain:**  

Integrated project plans
  
Release schedules
  
Milestone tracking
  
Resource forecasting
  
Executive dashboards
  
Manage dependencies across multiple program and vendor organizations.
  
Drive issue resolution and escalation management.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
Experience
  
8\+ years of experience delivering large\-scale technology programs.
  
5\+ years of experience managing cash management, complex financial services, banking, fintech, or payments initiatives.
  
Experience leading enterprise integration, platform modernization, or acquisition integration programs.
  
Experience with cash management, digital assets and stablecoin
  
Demonstrated success managing cross\-functional delivery teams.
  
Technical Knowledge
  
  

**Strong understanding of:**  

API\-based integrations
  
Cloud\-native architectures (AWS preferred)
  
Microservices and distributed systems
  
Core banking or financial platforms
  
Payment processing and money movement
  
Data integration and reconciliation processes
  
Security and regulatory requirements in financial services
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or SAFe certifications.
  
  

**Prior experience with:**  

Banking products
  
Deposits and treasury management
  
Payment networks
  
Digital assets
  
Financial institution integrations
  
M\&A integration programme experience
  
Experience working with modern banking cores.
  
  

Leadership Competencies
  
Excellent executive communication skills.
  
Strong technical acumen and problem\-solving ability.
  
Ability to influence without direct authority.
  
Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
  
Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, highly regulated environments.
  
Ability to balance strategic planning with hands\-on delivery execution.
  
  

**Ideal Candidate Profile:** A hands\-on Technical Program Manager with strong banking and fintech experience who can bridge strategy, architecture, engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders while driving delivery of complex integration programmes.

* Ability to facilitate clients' most complex business requirements

Required:

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Revenue Operations Analyst supports the firm's corporate revenue programs and its enterprise technology and data agreements, working with program owners to maintain data, prepare reporting, track obligations, and coordinate follow\-up. This role works across Sales, Operations, Growth, Accounting, FP\&A, Legal, Marketing, and Technology.
  

  

The firm is scaling a set of corporate revenue programs, including strategic partnerships, qualified leads, and managed accounts, that generate revenue alongside the agent platform. It is also expanding a centralized model for the enterprise software and data agreements that support the field. Both require the same discipline: clean attribution, tracked obligations, recurring reporting, and a clear view of what the firm earns and what it spends. This role supports that discipline and prepares the reporting that shows what each program and agreement returns.  

  

The base salary range for this role is $115,000– $130,000 per year. This position is eligible for a discretionary performance\-based bonus. The exact bonus is not guaranteed and will vary based on individual performance, team results, and company performance. Actual pay will be determined by factors such as education, experience, and job\-related skills relevant to the role. Marcus \& Millichap is a multi\-state employer and posted salary ranges are provided in good faith for compliance with all relevant pay\-transparency regulations. These ranges may not reflect potential compensation for positions based in other states or regions.**Responsibilities**

**Revenue Program Operations.** Support the day\-to\-day operations across the firm's corporate revenue programs: strategic partnerships, qualified leads, and managed accounts. Working alongside each program's owner, maintain the operating flow and attribution model for each within the CRM, and help extend them as the programs evolve. Reconcile partner\-reported figures against internal data and flag variances and amounts owed for resolution. Document program rules and standard operating procedures as they are agreed. Recommend changes to program design where the data warrants. Support partner relationship coverage as the portfolio scales.

**Revenue Tech Stack \& Vendor Governance****.** Maintain a firmwide inventory of the platforms, data subscriptions, and productivity tools the sales organization runs on. Track contract terms, cost, license counts, and utilization for each, so renewal decisions are made on evidence. Run a central calendar of obligations, renewals, and notice periods spanning partner and vendor agreements. Provide the usage and cost analysis that informs subscription strategy and consolidation decisions, and support tool evaluation and renewal negotiations. Support day\-to\-day vendor communications for select tools, including reporting requests, escalation tracking, and renewal preparation.

**Agent Support Spend****.** Run the day\-to\-day process for agent support dollars: partner with Accounting on attribution, maintain the approval and provisioning workflow, and prepare reporting on utilization and cost allocation. Help shape how allocations are tracked as the program formalizes.

**Financial Attribution \& Reporting****.** Prepare the recurring reporting that connects program and agreement performance to the firm's financials, covering attribution accuracy, referral conversion, managed account performance, and return on engagement. Apply consistent measurement standards from launch so programs can be compared as they scale. Partner with Accounting and FP\&A so revenue earned and spend committed are attributed, invoiced, and recorded correctly, connecting program and vendor economics to the firm's P\&L. Report on program impact for market, divisional, and finance leadership.

**The Person**

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–4 years in business operations, revenue operations, vendor or contract management, financial planning and analysis, or a comparable analytical and operational role.
* Working knowledge of financial data, including cost, revenue, and budget reporting.
* Comfort working with data in Excel, a CRM (Salesforce preferred), and a business intelligence platform (Tableau preferred). Able to define requirements, validate what is built, and prepare reporting. Administrator\-level expertise is not required.
* Track record of owning a recurring process with financial consequence, such as a close, a reconciliation, a renewal cycle, or a reporting package.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with how a P\&L is structured.
* Experience administering vendor contracts, renewals, or software licensing at scale.
* Experience supporting a workforce of independent contractors, franchisees, or other populations where program adoption depends on demonstrated value.
* Commercial real estate, professional services, or brokerage exposure.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and comfort using AI tools within a daily workflow.
**Competencies \& Characteristics**

* Comfortable where definitions, systems, and precedent are still being established.
* Strong written and verbal communication; effective with both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Identifies what needs to happen next and moves it forward.
* Follows a discrepancy to its source rather than working around it.
* Thinks critically about the work and brings solutions alongside the problems.
* Self\-motivated, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities.

new_jobs.title: AI / Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand\-New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission\-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

  

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

  

Peraton is seeking a talented **AI / Data Analyst** to support the development and application of AI\-enabled solutions within a mission\-focused environment. In this role, you will work with modern Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and cloud\-based AI technologies to turn complex data into intelligent, scalable applications.

  

This opportunity is suited for professionals with backgrounds in intelligence analysis, all\-source analysis or data analysis, who apply their analytical expertise to emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI capabilities. We are looking for individuals who understand how to work with diverse data sources, identify patterns and relationships, evaluate information, and turn complex data into meaningful insights.

  

**Work Location:**


* This position is required to be **100% on\-site** located in Herndon, VA.
  

**Your Impact:**


In this role, you will help move AI capabilities from concept to production, developing secure and responsible solutions that allow users to interact with complex information in faster and more intuitive ways. This role provides an opportunity for experienced Data Analysts to bring their existing skills into the rapidly evolving world of Generative AI and advanced data analytics without requiring a traditional software\-engineering career path.


* Collect, organize, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple sources.
* Evaluate large and diverse datasets to identify patterns, trends, relationships, anomalies, and potential risks.
* Apply analytical techniques to transform complex information into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Support the use of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze, summarize, categorize, and extract insights from information.
* Develop and refine prompts to improve the quality and accuracy of AI\-generated results.
* Evaluate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, completeness, and consistency.
* Research and correlate information across multiple data sources to develop a more complete understanding of complex issues.
* Assist with preparing data for AI\-enabled analysis, including data validation, cleansing, normalization, tagging, and organization.
* Support dashboards, reports, visualizations, and analytical products that communicate findings to stakeholders.
* Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, software developers, and mission stakeholders to translate analytical requirements into AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Identify opportunities where AI, automation, and advanced analytics can improve existing analytical processes.
* Document analytical methodologies, data sources, assumptions, findings, and recommendations.
* Apply appropriate data governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices when handling sensitive information.
  

**Why This Role Matters**


Modern AI is only as effective as the data, analytical thinking, and mission understanding behind it. Your ability to examine information from multiple sources, recognize relationships, challenge assumptions, and identify meaningful insights will help shape how AI capabilities are developed and used.


##### **Qualifications**


**Basic Qualifications**


* U.S. Citizenship Required.
* Must have the ability to obtain / maintain a Public Trust clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree and 12 years of experience or Master's degree and 10 years of experience or Associate’s degree and 14 years of experience or HS diploma/equivalent and 16 years’ experience.
* Background as an Intelligence Analyst, All\-Source Analyst, Data Analyst, Research Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar analytical professional.
* Experience integrating, manipulating, or analyzing information from multiple disparate data sources.

**Continuity (PWS 5\.4\.14\)**

* Train new FUP Branch government personnel on the unwritten TARC battle rhythm. Document processes so a replacement is productive on day one.

We’re actively seeking a talented Sr. Operations Analyst to join our team in Omaha, NE or Newport Beach, CA.

  

The Senior Operations Analyst serves as a strategic partner to business leaders by owning the Quality Control framework for back office operations and delivering actionable insights through advanced data analysis and reporting. This role combines QC oversight, business analysis, and data analytics to ensure operational service delivery is performed in line with expectations, SLAs, and regulatory requirements — while also supporting decision\-making, improving operational efficiency, and driving cost reduction across the organization. Sitting within the business/Operations team, the position serves as the bridge between Operations and Technology, translating business and QC needs into clear reporting requirements without owning system build or development. The role plays a critical part in driving operational health, mitigating risk, and enhancing reporting capabilities that align with business objectives.

  

How you’ll help move us forward:


Reporting Responsibilities

* Researches, collects, analyzes, models, and reports on data used to support decisions on day\-to\-day operations and to assess business and performance issues with a focus on quality, productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction.
* Researches internal and external best practices and QC benchmarks to establish standards for use in evaluating operations.
* Supports reporting across the operating model, with the ability to deliver platform\-specific and integrated views — including QC dashboards, SLA performance, and error trend reporting.
* Understands end\-to\-end business drivers, including valuation and pricing, and partners with Pricing/Actuarial teams to ensure reporting and analysis reflect core business economics.
* Serves as the bridge between Operations and Technology, collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders (Operations, Technology, Finance, Compliance) to translate business and QC needs into clear reporting requirements — without owning build, development, or system configuration.
* Researches, collects, and analyzes operational and performance data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities.
* Identifies and recommends enhancements to reporting techniques, and analytical tools to drive operational health, and hands off well\-scoped requirements to Technology for execution.
* Identifies and fills operational reporting gaps by working directly with Operations leaders on high\-impact process areas.


Quality Control (QC) Responsibilities

* Maintain an audit\-ready trail of QC reviews, findings, and resolutions to support internal audit, compliance, and external regulatory reviews.

Elior, filiale d'Elior Group, est n°1 en restauration collective en France. Depuis plus de 25 ans, nous anticipons les évolutions de notre métier, en devançant les attentes et les besoins des enfants, élèves, étudiants, travailleurs, patients et résidents…

**About the Team**


OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment.


**About the Role**


As a Legal Program Manager focused on regulatory compliance, you will build and manage cross\-functional programs that translate counsel’s guidance into practical, sustainable operations. Your initial focus may include content moderation and/or frontier AI governance, with the mix shaped by team priorities and your strengths.


You will partner with internal and external counsel, other legal program managers, and technical and business teams to coordinate implementation, evidence collection, reporting, and ongoing compliance. You’ll build repeatable systems that scale across regulations, products, and jurisdictions, helping teams navigate emerging requirements with clarity and sound judgment.


This full\-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY.


**In this role, you will:**


* Lead regulatory compliance programs end to end: define scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths, and drive execution with counsel and cross\-functional partners.
* Translate counsel’s regulatory guidance into repeatable workflows, controls, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include content moderation disclosures, transparency reporting, reporting and appeals workflows, or frontier AI model launch readiness, evaluation and risk\-management evidence, and incident reporting.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, User Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Global Affairs, Communications, and Go\-to\-Market to align program priorities and deliverables.
* Support regulatory inquiries, audits and investigations with counsel, organizing evidence and responses to support timely, accurate communication and reporting.
* Maintain a reliable source of truth for obligations, controls, decisions, evidence, and reporting. Demonstrate compliance readiness and control effectiveness, and improve program timeliness and evidence quality.
* Identify execution risks and compliance gaps, track remediation, and escalate blockers. Establish clear success measures and operating cadences, keeping legal conclusions subject to counsel’s review.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**


* Have 6\+ years of experience in program management, regulatory compliance, or related fields in a tech\-forward or highly regulated environment, including relevant legal, regulatory, or compliance program experience.
* Have experience working with an in\-house legal team; regulatory matters experience and in\-house technology experience are strongly preferred.
* Have demonstrated experience building and scaling compliance programs, translating legal or regulatory requirements into operational workflows, and maintaining reliable documentation and evidence in partnership with counsel.
* Take ownership of complex projects, set and achieve milestones, synthesize cross\-functional input, and build trust across legal, technical, and business teams.
* Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and make progress through ambiguity.
* Are resourceful and hands\-on, with enthusiasm for AI technology and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technical concepts and navigate fast\-moving technical environments.
* Bring familiarity with content moderation, online safety, frontier AI governance, data governance, privacy, or emerging technology law as a plus. Depth in either content moderation or frontier AI governance is valuable; expertise in both is not required.
* Bring data analysis or SQL skills, or relevant professional qualifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, CPA, or CISSP, as a plus.

**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.
