new_jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Global Research Operations (GRO) Program Managers build and scale global research programs to strengthen the impact of our research teams. We drive efficiency, cultivate relationships, increase knowledge sharing, and build capacity within our organization to enable our stakeholders to do their most impactful work. In this role, you will define, establish, and maintain global operational and team\-wide programs and create, manage, and scale processes that support a growing team. You'll draw on a full range of organizational and interpersonal skills to help our team operate effectively and deliver high\-impact work.The Competitive Intelligence Program Manager supports strategic initiatives in partnership with cross\-functional groups (e.g., Sourcing, Privacy, and Legal) to coordinate the acquisition and maintenance of external data sources. We are looking for a systems thinker who works in an AI\-native way, and who can provide strategic program direction, support operational excellence, guide the data sourcing process, and build strong cross\-functional partnerships that advance our vendor portfolio and governance posture. This position helps fill strategic gaps in the competitive data landscape, deepening the team's shared understanding of the product landscape, including trends, players, technologies, and underlying dynamics.  

  

  

### **Competitive Intelligence Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Meta Sourcing and the Privacy teams to complete new data contracts and renewals, bringing agreements to completion in a timely fashion while ensuring compliance requirements are met
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, and propose approaches that expand data coverage and realize more value from existing vendor relationships
* Guide vendor management best practices and governance by building strong working relationships with current and prospective vendors, and support negotiation of pricing decisions and sensitive terms
* Define clear program roadmaps, share frequent program updates, surface and communicate risks and adjustments, and ensure commitments are delivered
* Partner with stakeholders on internal processes, templates, and guidelines that improve team optimization and documentation
* Define and manage strategic initiatives that improve team efficiency and impact, and establish the operational systems that support them
* Work in an AI\-native way by integrating AI into your workflows to support productivity, innovation, and quality, adapting to new technologies and sharing best practices to support team\-wide AI adoption
* Serve as a connection point to the Global Research Ops team, adopting new processes and best practices where relevant and collaborating on programs specific to the team's needs

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of experience in program or project management, with a focus on vendor management or business operations
* 2\+ years of experience managing cross functional data projects (3P data source integration) in a corporate or similar role
* Experience in data modeling, project tracking, including advanced proficiency with Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides
* Experience with establishing programs and leading them end\-to\-end while scaling for growth
* Experience building relationships with peers and senior stakeholders, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams across multiple locations
* Experience communicating with data to drive change
* Experience managing competing priorities and shifting requirements independently, and resolving operational problems as they surface

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

* Experience with data privacy considerations in the consumer internet space, including social, communications, media, and/or entertainment verticals
* Experience communicating with leadership and contributing to product decisions

new_jobs.description:
**Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation Manager**  

  

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on October 31, 2026  

  

**Work You'll Do**  

  

As a Manager, Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation, you will be responsible for:  

* Working on integrated project teams on a range of projects covering the entire lifecycle from strategy formulation through to design, development and the deployment of solutions.
* Bringing considerable billing management expertise to help design, develop and implement subscription billing solutions to transform client's billing processes.
* Interacting daily with key business and IT executives
* Leading multiple teams in various strategy and implementation activities.
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues
* Determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches
* Evaluating and validate analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Implementing and overseeing the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day\-to\-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.

  

The successful Manager you will possess:  

* Strong communication skills \- ability to communicate complex system concepts to a business audience in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to facilitate clients' most complex business requirements
* Knowledge of basic accounting policies, and implications
* Experience identifying creative solutions within configurable cloud systems or within boundary applications where customization is required
* Leadership \- proven ability to lead complex engagements, both business and technical, including multiple dependencies and integration points
* Problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment

  

**The Team**  

  

Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 5\+ years experience in subscription billing within consulting or industry, specifically focused on delivering cloud\-based subscription billing solutions
* 5\+ years experience with end\-to\-end implementations of Subscription Billing solutions (e.g. Zuora Billing, Oracle NetSuite, SAP BRIM)
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* A Bachelor's degree

  

Preferred:
  

* Minimum 4 years of experience designing or optimizing lead\-to\-cash and record\-to\-report processes and end\-to\-end architectures.
* 4\+ years of direct experience across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including Design, Build, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Support.
* 4\+ years of practical experience applying Agile and Scrum methodologies to deliver technology or business solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience conducting architecture assessments and developing implementation roadmaps for subscription billing solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience designing and configuring cloud or SaaS\-based billing solutions in complex, multi\-entity environments.
* 3\+ years of experience designing integrations with upstream systems (such as Ordering, Provisioning) and downstream ERP applications (such as General Ledger)
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing teams of 5 or more people, including responsibility for performance, deliverables, and team development.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $ 134,500 \- $265,100\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.description:
1\.0 FTE Full time Day \- 08 Hour R2659837 Onsite 108610025 Admin Enterprise Contact Ctr Administrative Support NEWARK, 7600 Gateway Blvd, California
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  


Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

Stanford Health Care's Enterprise Contact Center (ECC) serves as a shared services platform supporting patient scheduling, nurse triage, referral coordination, and multi\-specialty contact center operations across the SHC care delivery network. The CRM Program Manager owns the Epic CRM program for the enterprise contact center ecosystem — the taxonomy, standards, governance, and operational workflows that determine how every patient contact is categorized, routed, documented, and reported. This role is the connective tissue between Epic's Contact Hub and CRM capabilities, the Panviva knowledge base, the new omnichannel platform's CTI integration, and the operational teams who rely on all of them working together seamlessly. Business requirements, workflow validation, UAT, and operational sign\-off are owned by this role; Epic/TDS teams own technical build, configuration, functional testing, and integration testing.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care  

  

**What you will do*** Epic CRM Program Ownership
* Owns the Epic CRM program including taxonomy, standards, foundational structure, and governance to ensure consistency across ECC and non\-ECC contact center teams.
* Defines the CRM standards framework for new builds, modifications, naming conventions, categories, outcomes, and documentation practices, and hold Epic/TDS technical teams accountable for consistent application across all contact center environments to support operational consistency, reporting integrity, and omnichannel readiness.
* Serves as the single business owner of the CRM data model — defining and enforcing the hierarchy of contact types, categories, subcategories, dispositions, and follow\-up actions that agents select to classify every patient interaction across the enterprise, ensuring the taxonomy supports cascading navigation and consistent disposition selection.
* Epic Contact Hub \& Workflow Operations
* Serves as the operational lead for Epic Contact Hub workflows, ensuring configurations, CRM workflows, and the agent experience remain aligned to operational needs and future omnichannel capabilities.
* Develops deep expertise in Epic scheduling decision trees and own the navigation between CRM workflows and decision tree usage to create a seamless staff experience and reduce workflow friction during patient interactions.
* Designs and optimizes agent\-facing workflows that minimize clicks, reduce cognitive load, and guide staff through complex patient scenarios (multi\-department scheduling, referral chains, prior authorization) with contextual CRM prompts.
* Leads User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CRM workflow changes prior to deployment, validating that business requirements are met and operational workflows perform as expected; functional testing, configuration testing, and integration testing are owned by Epic/TDS technical teams.
* Knowledge Base Alignment \& Content Governance
* Ensures CRM follow\-up actions, dispositions, and next steps are appropriately classified and aligned with Panviva knowledge base content so that guidance remains intuitive, duplication is minimized, and staff receive a consistent experience across systems.
* Partners with the knowledge management team to maintain a mapping between CRM disposition codes and corresponding Panviva articles — ensuring that when an agent selects a disposition, the relevant guidance surfaces automatically.
* Identifies and remediates content drift: cases where CRM workflow changes have made knowledge base articles stale, or where new knowledge base content requires corresponding CRM taxonomy updates.
* Supports the transition from Panviva to any future knowledge management platform (e.g., CXone Expert, Genesys Knowledge) by ensuring CRM\-to\-KB mappings are documented and portable.
* Governance, Intake \& Change Management
* Oversees CRM governance, intake, prioritization, and change review to ensure CRM changes are vetted against standards and evaluated for impact to routing logic, reporting, Contact Hub workflows, knowledge base dependencies, and integrations.
* Partners with Epic, TDS, operations, PMO, and other stakeholders to evaluate CRM\-related requests, define business requirements, and assess downstream impact prior to implementation.
* Establishes a CRM change advisory process: no CRM taxonomy or workflow change goes to production without documented impact assessment covering routing, reporting, KB alignment, and agent experience.
* Owns the end\-to\-end operational change management for omnichannel CTI and Epic CRM rollout, ensuring workflows, documentation standards, staff readiness, and adoption are implemented in a coordinated manner.
* Develops and delivers CRM\-specific training for new agents, supervisors, and operational leads — not just how to use the system, but why the taxonomy matters and how their inputs drive downstream reporting and patient experience.
* Reporting \& Data Integrity
* Drives CRM reporting maturity by partnering on reporting standards, data integrity, and sustainable reporting structures to support operational insights and decision\-making.
* Defines and monitors CRM data quality metrics: disposition completion rates, categorization accuracy, decision tree completion rates, and follow\-up action closure rates.
* Partners with the Reporting/BI Analyst to design CRM\-sourced dashboards that give operations leaders visibility into contact patterns, resolution rates, escalation trends, and agent workflow efficiency.
* Identifies and resolves systemic data quali

new_jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 09/29/2026Meet the Team
  
The CX Pricing Operations (CXPO) team acts as the backbone for services pricing across the entire CX portfolio, ensuring our financial strategies align with market realities. We bridge the gap between product management and finance, translating complex business goals into actionable pricing strategies and SKU mappings. Our team thrives on precision and collaboration, working across functional boundaries to maintain the health and integrity of our global pricing data. Joining us means being at the center of Cisco’s monetization strategy, where your work directly impacts how we deliver value to our customers and partners worldwide.
  
  

Your Impact
  
As a CXPO Pricing Business Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining the accuracy and efficiency of our global services pricing lifecycle. You will execute complex price changes and service mappings, ensuring all systems are synchronized and aligned with our strategic goals. You will perform regular data integrity audits to identify and resolve discrepancies, safeguarding the financial health of our service offerings. You will partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to navigate dynamic business requirements, transforming complex data into actionable insights that support informed, strategic decision\-making. Additionally, you will support competitive benchmarking projects to inform our broader pricing strategy. By developing and refining repeatable processes, you will directly contribute to the operational excellence and scalability of our pricing team.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
We value demonstrated skills and practical experience. To be considered for this role, you must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* 2–4 years of practical experience in business operations and data analysis.
* Demonstrated proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, lookup formulas, logical functions, data validation).
* Proven experience managing large, complex datasets with a high degree of accuracy.
* Demonstrated ability to proactively identify operational obstacles and follow through on tasks to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage in constructive debate to resolve challenges.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in translating complex business problems into structured project plans.
* Proven ability to synthesize data\-backed insights into recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Experience in process re\-engineering or building repeatable playbooks to drive operational scalability.
* Experience with Cisco internal pricing and quoting tools (e.g., CCW) or comparable enterprise\-level pricing/quoting platforms.
* Hands\-on experience leveraging AI tools for advanced data analysis, predictive modeling, and generating actionable business insights.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
